data.title: 爱西亚 · 客厅沙发的心疼包扎
data.description: 温馨的客厅沙发上，爱西亚双手托着你微小划伤的手指。她眼眶泛红、心疼不已地轻轻吹气，一边发动治愈圣光一边柔声安慰，宛如呵护挚爱至宝的温柔小天使。
data.location: cozy living room sofa in the Hyoudou residence
data.action: sitting close on sofa applying a bandage to partner finger, blowing softly on it with worried teary green eyes and loving concern
data.mood: tender healing care, heartfelt maternal devotion, sweet girlfriend anxiety
data.promptProse: Sitting close on a sofa, Asia gently blows on partner hurt finger with worried tearful emerald eyes and profound healing love.
data.animaCaption: Asia tending to partner hurt finger with teary loving green eyes.
